parameters.name: IEEE802dot1Bridge
parameters.description: Indicates whether or not the 1905 link includes one or more IEEE 802.1 bridges. If {{false}}, the 1905 link does not include an IEEE 802.1 bridge. If {{true}}, the 1905 link does include one or more IEEE 802.1 bridges.

parameters.name: PacketErrors
parameters.description: Estimated number of lost {{units}} on the transmit side of the link {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-18: 1905 transmitter link metrics}} during a measurement period.

parameters.name: PacketErrorsReceived
parameters.description: Estimated number of lost {{units}} on the receive side of the link {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-20: 1905 receiver link metrics}} during a measurement period.

parameters.name: TransmittedPackets
parameters.description: Estimated number of {{units}} sent to the Neighbor on this {{object|##.Link}}, in the same measurement period used to estimate {{param|PacketErrors}}.

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.description: Estimated number of {{units}} received from this Neighbor on this {{object|##.Link}} {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-20: 1905 receiver link metrics}}, in the same measurement period used to estimate {{param|PacketErrors}}.

parameters.name: MACThroughputCapacity
parameters.description: The maximum MAC throughput in {{units}} between this {{object|###.Interface}} and the Neighbor on this {{object|##.Link}} that is estimated at this {{object|###.Interface}}.

parameters.name: LinkAvailability
parameters.description: The estimated average {{units}} of time that the {{object|##.Link}} is available for data transmissions.

parameters.name: PHYRate
parameters.description: The Physical Layer (PHY) rate in {{units}} between this {{object|###.Interface}} and the Neighbor on this {{object|##.Link}} that is estimated at this {{object|###.Interface}}.

parameters.name: RSSI
parameters.description: The estimated Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) ratio in {{units}} between this {{object|###.Interface}} and the Neighbor on this {{object|##.Link}} that is estimated at the receive side of this {{object|###.Interface}}.

object.description: This object represents the metrics for this {{object|##.Link}} as defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Tables 6-18: 1905 transmitter link metrics and Table 6-20: 1905 receiver link metrics}}.
